notes: All three probes used newly owned private-Xvfb Rhino sessions and public APIs, never an existing user window or proprietary implementation.
All 200 results are retained without changing observation values; the two 64-case aperture batches are concatenated with identical response metadata.
The independent square reference and native replay retain 13 aperture target differences: five competing-wire cases and eight short-wire endpoint counterexamples on the reported component itself.
All 48 separate-object Near comparisons agree; seven combined-mesh comparisons differ. Between-object ranking is unchanged.
Native replay uses source geometry, actual camera/click, and snap policy only, at componentwise absolute epsilon 1e-9 and relative epsilon zero. None compares admission, not CPlane placement.
These probes do not establish full per-wire target or selection parity, arbitrary-scene behavior, model history, or a Rhino performance advantage.
